subject: Decision window: Priya Kapoor — compensation & headcount unblock

Subject: Priya Kapoor — offer window + competing interest

Hi team,

Quick context: Priya (candidate for Senior Model Ops Engineer, req-2345) interviewed last week and prefers Redwood but received a fast, higher base offer from a Series D competitor. She asked for our offer timeline and has given a verbal deadline of EOD Tuesday (6/26) to decide.

Recruiting recommends a candidate-friendly package with a modest geo uplift + 1-year signing bonus to close. I attached a baseline offer draft (v2) and the Q2 comp benchmark for context.

Can Jonás confirm if headcount is cleared at the band we intend to propose? Marcus — can you run a quick market delta and confirm if a one-time signing bonus + 10% base uplift would be within bounds for this role in US-west?

Attachments: Offer_Letter_Priya_Kapoor_v2.pdf, CompBenchmark_Q2_2028.xlsx

Thanks,
Naomi

Thanks Naomi — I can confirm the headcount is approved for this quarter and the band for Senior Model Ops is open (band 5). I want to avoid stretching comp on base if we can get acceptance via a short-term signing bonus + slightly higher equity. Priya's scope is cross-functional (serving runtime + infra) so retention is important.

If Marcus clears the signing bonus and equity bump, I'm comfortable authorizing up to a 12% base uplift and a $25k one-time signing bonus for this candidate. Need to balance internal parity.

—Jonas

> If Marcus clears the signing bonus and equity bump, I'm comfortable authorizing up to a 12% base uplift and a $25k one-time signing bonus for this candidate.

Quick read: the proposed 12% uplift + $25k signing bonus is within the allowable exceptions for this band if we tag it as a retention/competitive exception and document the business rationale. I attached the Q2 benchmark I referenced — note that the competitor's base is ~8-10% higher on median, so the uplift is defensible.

Two asks before I sign off officially: 1) confirm target start date (we should include a 6-week preferred start to allow transition); 2) if we add equity, agree the refresh cliff condition (we should not add extra refresh beyond standard manager discretionary pool).

Marcus
Compensation Partner
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Priya —

Great speaking with you last week. We’re excited by the possibility of you joining Redwood. Attached is an updated offer packet (Offer_Letter_Priya_Kapoor_v2.pdf). Highlights:
- Title: Senior Model Ops Engineer
- Base salary: $198,000 (12% uplift vs initial band midpoint)
- One-time signing bonus: $25,000 (paid on first paycheck)
- Equity: 0.35% RSU grant, standard 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff
- Target start: flexible, ideally mid-August (6 weeks)

We’d love to get your decision by EOD Tuesday (6/26) given competing timelines. If you need any adjustments, let me know and we can escalate.

Attachments: Offer_Letter_Priya_Kapoor_v2.pdf

Best,
Kimberly Park
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0110

Subject: Re: Offer from Redwood Inference — Priya Kapoor (Senior Model Ops Engineer)

Kimberly — thank you and the team for the offer and for moving quickly. I appreciate the uplift and bonus — this is very close to what I was hoping for.

Two pieces of information I need before I can make a final decision: 1) My competitor has included a guaranteed relocation stipend and an earlier start bonus (two weeks earlier). Can Redwood match a one-time $7k relocation allowance? 2) Curious if there's flexibility on accelerated vesting for the first-year cliff (I know this may be unusual).

I am trying to be fair to both teams — Samir copied here. I do need to respond by EOD today per my earlier note.

Thanks,
Priya
(priya.kapoor@gmail.com | 415-555-0223)
